title: MS4_Magnet
description: This plugin adds commands to make a magnet like on MineShield 4
body:
**MineShield Magnet**

I noticed that no one is making free plugins with MineShield.

So I decided to make a plugin that everyone really wants, and it's a magnet plugin from the popular MineShield 4 Season server.
If you have any questions or find bugs, write in the Discord channel [Discord](https://discord.gg/rPuczjnpgV)

**Plugin Information:**

The magnet attracts items or armor that contain diamonds/iron/gold/netherite in their crafting recipe.

When you first install the plugin on the server, a config file appears where you can configure many magnet functions, such as:

Attraction speed

Radius

Height

Sound settings (enable/disable, volume, pitch)

**✨ New Features:**

🔊 Magnet Sound - Added configurable sound when players are attracted to magnets (default: block.beacon.ambient). Customize sound type, volume, and pitch in config.yml

👻 Spectator Mode Protection - Players in spectator mode are no longer affected by magnets

🔘 Player Toggle Command - New command /magnettoggle (/mtoggle) allows players to enable or disable magnet attraction for themselves. All players are enabled by default

⚙️ Sound Settings - Added new section in config.yml to configure:

sound.enabled - Turn magnet sound on/off

sound.type - Choose any Minecraft sound

sound.volume - Adjust volume (0.0 - 1.0)

sound.pitch - Adjust pitch (0.5 - 2.0)

**Commands:**

🔄 **/magnetreload** (/mreload)

Reloads the plugin config

**Usage:** /magnetreload

**Permission:** magnet.admin

📍 **/magnetset** (/mset)

Places a magnet at the current location

**Usage:** /magnetset [name]

**Permission:** magnet.admin

❌ **/magnetdel** (/mdel)

Removes a magnet

**Usage:** /magnetdel <name>

**Permission:** magnet.admin

📋 **/magnetlist** (/mlist)

Shows all magnets

**Usage:** /magnetlist

**Permission:** magnet.admin

🖼️ **/magnetitems** (/mitems)

Opens a GUI menu to easily add/remove magnetic items without editing config files

**Usage:** /magnetitems or /mitems

**Permission:** magnet.admin

📄 **/magnetpage** (/mpage)

Opens a specific page of the item menu (1-5)

**Usage:** /magnetpage <1-5> or /mpage <1-5>

**Permission:** magnet.admin

🔘 **/magnettoggle** (/mtoggle)

Toggles magnet attraction for yourself (on/off)

**Usage:** /magnettoggle or /mtoggle

**Permission:** magnet.toggle (default: true for all players)

**Mini Versions of Commands:**

Command	| Alias

/magnetreload	/mreload

/magnetset	/mset

/magnetdel	/mdel

/magnetlist	/mlist
